name: moneytrack
description: Plateforme d'analyse et de gestion budgétaire personnelle

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @moneytrack/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @moneytrack/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @moneytrack/api && npm run build -w @moneytrack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
